rationale: Two uncontested no-man's-land markers are worth the same VP, so the only thing separating them is how many turns of movement each costs - an objective reached in round 2 scores in rounds 2-5, one reached in round 4 scores twice. A Move 6 unit placed 4 inches from obj_nml_1's ruin (14.02: in range once a base touches it) and 36 inches from obj_nml_2 should walk to the near one; nothing else is within a Move plus the best Advance. Getting this wrong is not a judgement call, it is arithmetic. Assert 1 checks the distances on the engine, so the exam cannot silently drift onto a different board again.
setup: # The board is the CURRENT fixture's (rebuilt 2026-08-21 in 38cbaa3,
# mirrored 2026-10-25 in 6f07340): obj_nml_1 is the marker at (1500, 750)
# inside the dense ruin area-large-2 (x 1360-1640, y 520-980), and 11e
# 14.02 puts a model within range of a terrain-hosted objective as soon as
# its base touches the hosting area - so "N inches from obj_nml_1" means
# N inches from that area. (Written for the dbdb29f board, where obj_nml_1
# was an open-ground marker at (400, 880), this exam kept those coordinates
# through both rebuilds and graded a squad 28" from the objective.)
# The squad: a line 65 px apart at y 328.5, every 40 mm base 4" north of
# the ruin's top edge (y 520), 36" from obj_nml_2's ruin (area-large-1).
# Park every other model at 70 px spacing (bases are 32-40 mm, < 63 px):
# player 1 in the north-west corner, more than 24" from the ruin, so no
# other friendly is a rival for obj_nml_1; player 2 in the south-east, so
# no enemy is within 30" of the squad and there is no threat to price.

assert.name: precondition: the start line is 4" short of obj_nml_1's range (14.02), every other objective is more than a Move plus the best Advance (12") away, and no enemy is within 30"
script: # Engine precondition, independent of the AI: rebuild the start line
# on a snapshot and measure it with the engine's own range geometry,
# so the exam fails here, loudly, if the fixture moves its objectives
# again (two rebuilds already did, silently). Negative = which premise
var ev = Vector2(float(ep.x), float(ep.y)) if not (ep is Vector2) else ep

assert.name: Custodian Guard closed on the near objective (in range of obj_nml_1), not the far one
script: # 0 when any model is within range of obj_nml_1 - the engine's own
# control predicate (a base touching area-large-2, 14.02); otherwise
# how far short the nearest model stopped, in inches.
return "obj_nml_1 is missing from the fixture"
